title: Still cannot believe I got to spend such a perfect little evening cel...
transcript: I went to an intimate dinner party with Rachel Reid to celebrate the release of the deluxe edition of Heated Rivalry. We took quizzes, we played games, we made toast. It was an absolutely perfect evening in honour of our favourite hockey player. I read heated rivalry in the Game Changers books for the first time in 2022, and this series has meant so much to me for such a long time, so I am extremely grateful for every friendship, experience, and opportunity that loving these books as loudly as I do has LED to. And genuinely, this is one of the coolest. Tyler and I got ready together and headed over to this adorable little wine bar for a night of rivalry and romance with Harlequin Books. The first thing I saw was Shane and Spicy Ginger Ale. I had, like, five. There were so good. Also, these cookies. I literally cry. And then we got a look at the new deluxe edition of Heated Rivalry. And this book is so pretty. The foil, the artwork. I wanna frame it. But this was just such a cozy evening. It was only, like, 15 people, and the vibes were amazing. We chatted about books, we played some air hockey, and then Rachel Reid herself, our mother, walked into the restaurant. Rachel is currently on tour, making a bunch of stops in the U S. And Canada, so it was amazing that she took time to come meet with us and She's so nice, and I had so much to say, and then I just forgot all of it, and instead we talked about the Arena Foundation and Kate Spade. Now they should do a collection, which. True, but Rachel was genuinely so cool and funny, and I cannot wait for unrival. This entire night was just so surreal. And then it was time for dinner, and everything was heated rivalry themed. Great food, great people, great conversations. We did a little Cosmo quiz of figuring out your favourite genre. Mine was obviously yearning and pining. And then they announced they were doing heated rivalry trivia, and the winner would get the entire Game Changer series, the deluxe edition with the new sprayed edges. Something about me is I get a little embarrassed when there's too much tension on me. So I was not planning on winning, but then I really wanted these books, so I won. Was I mildly embarrassed to reveal how much heated rivalry knowledge I had? Maybe. Was it worth it? Absolutely. Anyway, thank you, Harlequin for this absolutely beautiful night. And make sure to pick up a deluxe edition of Heated Rivalry. It's a must for the collection.
